The comparison harness is now doing its job: most semantic cases match, but Windows newline translation and console encoding are byte-visible.

I’m adjusting stdout to emit `\n` exactly and to use the same encoding style as the reference binary for table characters.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, binascii
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=str(pathlib.Path('executable.cmd').resolve())
for label, cmd in [('ref',[nu,'-c','[1 2]']),('py',[exe,'-c','[1 2]'])]:
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True)
 print(label, binascii.hexlify(r.stdout[:20]), r.stdout[:20])
'@ | python -"
